scope_boundary: This registry covers the active evidence surfaces explicitly inspected in this wave. It is not a claim that every gap in every RAFAELIA repository or private corpus has been enumerated.

authority.producer_rule: Mapa may route and reconcile producer gaps but may not promote producer execution or scientific truth without producer evidence.

private_provenance_policy: Public records use opaque Drive aliases; raw private provider IDs and locators are excluded.
